Adding form to SPlus

I just committed changes to SAMICAS2, SAMICAS3, and SAMICSV to add the Chest X-Ray form to the system.

You can see it work on vendev5. 

It needs to be tested.
adding cxform must be added to the install instructions:


VAPALS YottaDB> D Q^DI


VA FileMan 22.2


Select OPTION: ENTER OR EDIT FILE ENTRIES



Input to what File: SAMI FOR
     1   SAMI FORM                        (0 entries)
     2   SAMI FORM MAPPING                (30 entries)
CHOOSE 1-2: 2  SAMI FORM MAPPING          (30 entries)
EDIT WHICH FIELD: ALL//

You may enter a new SAMI FORM MAPPING, if you wish
        NAME MUST BE 3-30 CHARACTERS, NOT NUMERIC OR STARTING WITH
        PUNCTUATION

Select SAMI FORM MAPPING: vapals:cxform
  Are you adding 'vapals:cxform' as a new SAMI FORM MAPPING (the 31ST)? No// ye
s  (Yes)
INDEXED BY:
FILEMAN FILE (DEFAULT):
GRAPH:
Select VARIABLE:
HTML TEMPLATE NAME: xray.html


Select SAMI FORM MAPPING:
